newsitem.title: USA: Speiker Properties sets 10 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Speiker Properties sets 10 mln shr offering.

text.p: Speiker Properties Inc said Tuesday it priced a public offering of 10 million of its common stock at $34.50 a share.

The company said in a statement it originally planned to sell eight million shares, but increased the offering due to better than expected demand and recently identified additional acquisition opportunities.

Speiker said the $326.1 million of net proceeds from the offering will be used by to purchase commercial property that it has under contract, to repay debt and fund future acquisitions and developments.
Spieker owns and operates about 21.5 million square feet of suburban commercial properties in California and the Pacific Northwest.
